requirements.text: Customers should be able to book appointments online through a user-friendly interface on a website or mobile app.
System should allow customers to select services, barbers, and available time slots in real-time.
The system should send automated SMS and email reminders to customers 24 hours and 1 hour before their appointments, including appointment details and options to cancel or reschedule.
Barbers should have the ability to set their availability, breaks, and time off directly through the system.
System should allow barbers to make last-minute adjustments to their schedules.
The system should provide daily and weekly summaries of appointments, cancellations, no-shows, and peak times.
There should be a mechanism to track customer no-show history and identify patterns for targeted outreach or manual booking review.
The system should provide insights into customer preferences and barber popularity to inform operational decisions.
The booking system must provide clear descriptions and prices for all services offered.
Customers should receive immediate confirmation via SMS and email once they book an appointment.
The booking interface must be user-friendly and straightforward to minimize customer effort.
The system must ensure real-time availability to avoid double bookings.
The system should allow customers to cancel or reschedule their appointments online without having to call the shop.
The system must provide a feature for barbers to define their regular working hours.
The system should allow barbers to block off time for breaks during their shifts.
The system must comply with relevant data protection regulations for customer data storage.
